Aikatsu Stars! My Special Appeal.name: Aikatsu Stars! My Special Appeal
Aikatsu Stars! My Special Appeal.summary: Aikatsu Stars! My Special Appeal is the second 3DS game of the Data Carddass Aikatsu Stars! arcade series, and is the expansion of Aikatsu Stars! First Appeal.

Labyrinth no Kanata.name: Labyrinth no Kanata
Labyrinth no Kanata.summary:
Labyrinth no Kanata is a first-person RPG dungeon crawler for the Nintendo 3DS. The game was only released in Japan.

The game revolves around a group of players who have begun playing an online multiplayer game, only to find themselves thrust into a world completely different from theirs. They encounter a girl who has become trapped in this world's Labyrinth, and the two parties must work together to find a way out.

Rabbids Rumble.name: Rabbids Rumble
Rabbids Rumble.summary: Rabbids have escaped from your cartridge all over your Nintendo 3DS and found their way into the real world. You must collect them throughout 7 worlds full of mini games and bring the complete collection back, one battle at the time!

Secret Mysteries in London.name: Secret Mysteries in London
Secret Mysteries in London.summary: 1920. When a politician is found murdered in the park, the local police make the unconventional decision to ask Oscar Gaebelein, a young forensic scientist, for help. Motivated by his desire to prove his value to the investigating team, Oscar throws himself head first into the investigation. But soon, he and his colleagues find out that this first murder is only the beginning of a sinister bread crumb trail.
